releaseNotes.en: Each lease now opens with one next step and a five-step progress row, worked out from your records. Lease members sit right after the move-in record, so inviting the landlord follows recording. On phones the main sections move to a bottom bar, one tap away. Returning users see Create a lease folded away, and new users see the guide first. Calmer cards, buttons and header. Records, photos and decisions are unchanged. Release build: the practice workspace and its demo accounts are gone; phones that still have them are moved back to their own records.
releaseNotes.zh: 每份租约顶部新增“下一步”与五步进度，均按你的记录计算。租约成员移到入住记录之后，记录完即可邀请房东。手机端主导航改为底部栏，一次点击即可切换。已有租约时“创建租约”自动折叠，新用户先看到新手引导。卡片、按钮与顶部栏更简洁。记录、照片与决定均不受影响。正式版：移除练习空间及其演示账号；仍保留这些内容的手机会自动回到自己的记录。
